#!/usr/bin/python3
import hashlib
import http.server
import os
import socketserver
import ssl
import threading

CERT = "/etc/https8443/server.crt"
KEY = "/etc/https8443/server.key"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path not in ("/", "/healthz"):
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        body = b"https8443 alive\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("X-Certificate-SHA256", self.server.cert_fingerprint)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

class ReloadingTLSServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def __init__(self, address, handler):
        self._tls_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._cert_identity = None
        self._tls_context = None
        self.cert_fingerprint = ""
        super().__init__(address, handler, bind_and_activate=False)
        self._reload_tls(force=True)
        self.server_bind()
        self.server_activate()
    def _reload_tls(self, force=False):
        identity = (os.stat(CERT).st_ino, os.stat(CERT).st_mtime_ns)
        if not force and identity == self._cert_identity:
            return
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
        context.load_cert_chain(CERT, KEY)
        pem = open(CERT, encoding="ascii").read()
        der = ssl.PEM_cert_to_DER_cert(pem)
        fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(der).hexdigest()
        with self._tls_lock:
            self._tls_context = context
            self._cert_identity = identity
            self.cert_fingerprint = fingerprint
        print("loaded certificate sha256=%s" % fingerprint, flush=True)
    def get_request(self):
        raw, address = self.socket.accept()
        try:
            self._reload_tls()
        except Exception as exc:
            print("certificate reload deferred: %s" % exc, flush=True)
        with self._tls_lock:
            context = self._tls_context
        try:
            return context.wrap_socket(raw, server_side=True), address
        except Exception:
            raw.close()
            raise

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ReloadingTLSServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_EOF
